entities.summary: Murō-ji is a Shingon Buddhist temple located in the city of Uda, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It lays on the mountainside of Mount Murō and historically served as a place of worship for the Japanese dragon associated with rain prayers known as Zennyo Ryūō. Its five-storied pagoda is one of the oldest standing pagodas in Japan, dating its construction to the 9th century. Murō-ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia, established in 800 CE.
